lexical_limitation_analysis.description: Stage 2 system notification dampening relies on lexical pattern matching (regex).
lexical_limitation_analysis.vulnerability_mitigation: Strict invariant enforced: presence of any external URL (has_link) or security threat intent immediately disqualifies dampening.
lexical_limitation_analysis.android_os_recommendation: Production Android implementation should additionally inspect StatusBarNotification package name (com.whatsapp, android, com.google.android.apps.docs) and notification channel ID (e.g. backup_channel) via SystemNotificationClassifier to prevent reliance on lexical text alone.
